content: Per-type custom fields without EAV: three viable patterns. Single wide table (STI-style) = simple queries but sparse NULL columns, discouraged at scale (GitLab). JSON/JSONB column = no migrations, GIN-indexable, weak typing, worse filter perf (Heap: 80% slowdown on hot event tables). Class Table Inheritance = typed columns + FKs per type, needs joins. Practitioner consensus: real columns for frequently-filtered fields, JSON for the variable tail; EAV only when fields are truly user-defined.
